objective: Speak to Tiza Battleforge in Ironforge

description: Hello, <name>. I know you're busy helping out the people of Dun Morogh, but when you have the time, you should go upstairs and speak to one of our most respected ilk: Tiza Battleforge. She's the one the younger paladins go to when it's time they learn more about the Light and what's expected of ya.
completion: Well met, <name>. I hope the Light shows you the true path and keeps you safe from evil.
